Yara: Kicking off micro-canary for release v3.7.4 -> 10% on /generate. Change window 2026-08-01 21:00 UTC. Deploybot will post steps.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: release=v3.7.4 traffic=10% route=/generate id=r-1801234567
```
deployctl start --id r-1801234567 --release v3.7.4 --canary 10 --route /generate
apply -f rollouts/r-1801234567.yaml
```

obs-bot: Baseline checks running: p95/p99, 5xx, mem RSS, kv-cache hitrate, gen-truncation. Dash: https://dash.redwood/rollouts/r-1801234567

Sam: Pinned runtime flags for canary: preload_kv=true, batch_max=6. Release notes updated.

deploy-bot: Canary applied. State=HEALTHY. Running 10m probe. Will post signals.

obs-bot: SIGNAL r-1801234567: p95 +35ms (3m), 5xx=0.07%, kv-cache miss +4%. No OOMs.

Ruth: Looks fine. Keep an eye on gen-truncation for long prompts.

obs-bot: ALERT r-1801234567: gen-truncation rate = 0.45% (2m), baseline 0.05%. Top sample ids attached. Logs: https://logs.redwood/rollouts/r-1801234567

Ana: That is above our threshold (0.3%). Recommending manual stop. Could be tokenization change in v3.7.4.

Yara: We can try shrinking to 3% and rotate canary with tokenization debug flags, or stop and rollback. Any preference?

Sam: Shrink+debug for one probe cycle to capture traces, unless SRE prefers immediate stop.

infra-bot: Note: rotating canary will restart pods and briefly reduce capacity. Ensure change window cushion.

obs-bot: Current rule: if gen-truncation >0.3% OR tokenization_err >0.2% -> stop. Manual STOP recommended.

Yara: Manual STOP requested by @Yara. Rollback plan: route -> v3.7.3, scale down canary, collect tokenizer dumps and failing inputs.

deploy-bot: STOP acknowledged. Executing rollback steps:
```
route set /generate --version=3.7.3
scale deployment llm-gen-v3.7.4 --replicas=0
collect-artifacts --id r-1801234567 --artifacts=tokenizer-dump,failing-inputs,heap-dump
kubectl annotate deployment llm-gen-v3.7.4 quarantined-by=obs-1801234567
```

Sam: Updating release notes: "Canary v3.7.4 rolled back to v3.7.3 due to elevated generation truncation in canary; preserved samples for triage." Tags: rollback, tokenizer, canary.

Yara: Confirmed rollback. Opening ticket R-11234 for tokenizer/regression investigation. Owners: @Sam and @Ana. Quick triage 2026-08-01 21:30 UTC. Thanks for quick responses. :handshake:
